title: Repeated perfect-fifth dyad escalates
purpose: confirms a perfect-fifth dyad attacked DYAD_REPETITION_THRESHOLD times within DYAD_REPETITION_WINDOW escalates to power chord.
expected_prose:
- First dyad (t=0 to t=200): state=melody (1 attack, no escalation)
- Second dyad (t=500 to t=700): state=melody (2 attacks within window, still below threshold of 3)
- Third dyad (t=1000 to t=1200): state=chord, identity=(G, '5'), confidence=declared. Three attacks within DYAD_REPETITION_WINDOW (2 beats = 1000ms; all three fall within this window from the first attack).
trailing_notes: Subtle: this test is sensitive to whether DYAD_REPETITION_WINDOW is measured forward from the first attack or rolling. Specify in implementation.
